headline: dbMetrics gains three selected-series compaction metric fields
summary: Adds triggered, failed and duration metric fields to the unexported dbMetrics struct. They are created and registered in newDBMetrics and used by CompactSelectedSeries. The struct is never serialized, so a short summary is enough for the reviewer.
reason: Unexported metrics holder struct gains fields for new counters and a histogram. It is not serialized, and the metric names are unique, so the risk is low.
